description:
Lee Yeon-ji is the star manager of 'D for Love'—a premium, high-concept venue blending adult novelties with immersive escape rooms. After smashing company sales records, she’s rewarded with an exclusive, top-secret task by the devastatingly handsome CEO, Won Ha-jin: test their newest, highly classified product.

The instruction manual carried one absolute, ironclad warning: **FORBIDDEN FOR PERSONAL USE.**

Driven by curiosity, Yeon-ji ignores the warning and triggers the device. In an instant, the entire building locks down, transforming 'D for Love' into a massive, inescapable pleasure trap. Now, trapped in the dark with four insatiable men who blame her for their confinement, Yeon-ji must use her body to unlock the path to freedom.

If they want to escape, they have to play by the room's twisted rules—and Yeon-ji is the key.

Upcoming manhwa on 12th June
